title: Host-observed test-run markers ("observed-…") stay state=running after the launcher-registered run they shadow has ended
outcome: A host-observed run record that corresponds to a launcher-registered run (or to a process that has exited) reaches a terminal state, so /api/test-runs does not show phantom running runs that block or confuse gate/cold scheduling.
acceptance: A deterministic reproduction exercises a host-observed observed-… execution that shadows a launcher run. Once that exact launcher run has ended, the test-run list, detail and published updates no longer present a separate stale running marker; they expose the associated run's factual PASS or FAIL and retain the observed execution's provenance and access to available PID/log information. Association requires positive execution/artifact identity and must not select an unrelated concurrent run merely because its session, worktree, preset or start time is similar.

An observed execution whose own terminal result is known, or whose execution/monitoring has definitively ended, stops being reported as running. When the workload's result cannot be established, including a removed worktree or unavailable artifacts after execution has ended, it reports explicit Unknown/interrupted with a reason rather than fabricating success or failure. Missing PID, missing logs, an idle owner, or a missing path alone does not prove a live workload ended. Detached/background launch acknowledgement is not a passing test result, and these visibility transitions mint no verification credit or relax existing claim/source/evidence authority.

Deterministic regressions fail on the original stale-marker behavior and pass on the correction, covering exact shadowed PASS and FAIL, definitive execution end without a launcher terminal result, artifact/worktree disappearance, genuinely live execution, unrelated concurrent executions, and persistence/restart behavior. Tests exercise the production reconciliation and API/publication paths without sleeps, live-store mutation, or weakening existing tests.

The corrected input has passing focused compile and regressions, a passing maintained five-stage full gate on the exact landing input, and independent read-only Codex plus Claude reviews with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding; all earlier such findings are fixed and re-reviewed. Completion uses a fresh independent acceptance evaluation after host-recorded checks settle.

completion.summary:
Host-observed observed-… test-run rows now reach a terminal state.
- An observed row that shadows a launcher run merges into that run's row and shows its factual PASS or FAIL, keeping the observed provenance.
- Ended executions whose result cannot be established show an explicit Unknown/interrupted.
- Genuinely live executions stay running.
